_: Real incidents on the systems behind this profile. Every one is checkable: the dates come from workflow runs, generatedAt stamps and git history. Add an entry when something breaks, close it when it is fixed. Nothing speculative belongs here.

incidents.title: Daily refresh red for 8 days, one dead regex
incidents.cause: A dash sweep turned 'HireSignal - active' into 'HireSignal: active' and the generator's regex hard-coded the punctuation. It exited 1 every day, and because the commit step was gated on success, 26 healthy generators were discarded with it.
incidents.fix: Match the number beside the phrase, never the punctuation between the words. Commit step now runs on always().

incidents.title: The freshness alarm could not see the largest generated file
incidents.cause: The scanner matched one stamp shape. store.ts emits a TypeScript const instead of the JSON-ish key, so 5,150 lines sat 21 days old and completely outside the alarm's view, with the suite green.
incidents.fix: Match both shapes, then pin store.ts in MUST_BE_STAMPED so it cannot fall out again.

incidents.title: chessDeep.ts reached 29 days stale under a 45-day alarm
incidents.cause: Not a dead generator. The daily job never reached it, because an earlier step exited non-zero. One blanket threshold tuned for the slowest source gave every other file weeks of legal silence.
incidents.fix: Per-file SLAs. Live daily sources get 21 days; the rate-limited Play sweep keeps 45.

incidents.title: The profile understated its own open source by 15 PRs
incidents.cause: The generator queried the private product repo while the sentence it maintains is about the public upstream. The request 422'd, the catch swallowed it, and the README sat at 9 merged PRs against a real 24.
incidents.fix: Read the public upstream, the same repo the portfolio reads. A fetch failure is still swallowed; a dead pattern now exits 1.

incidents.title: The homepage told every machine reader the platform served zero users
incidents.cause: The metric tile rendered a zero placeholder as its initial text and only reached the real figure through a count-up. Anything reading HTML without running it, an LLM screener, an ATS parser, a crawler, read 0k+ monthly active users.
incidents.fix: Ship the real value in the markup and zero the node at effect time instead. Guarded by a renderToStaticMarkup test.

incidents.title: kmp-toolkit's module count was stale by three, and self-contradictory
incidents.cause: 36 was right when there were 17 core modules. Three more landed and nothing re-measured. The same README already said 39 further down. No claim covered the number, so a passing audit never looked.
incidents.fix: Corrected on 8 surfaces and covered by a kmp-toolkit-modules claim, measured the same way as its siblings.

incidents.title: Two datasets aged out while a daily job reported success
incidents.cause: Every generator keeps the previous file on a fetch error, which is right, and means a broken source looks identical to a quiet one. chessDeep.ts was 25 days old and weeb.ts 19, with the job green throughout.
incidents.fix: freshness.test.ts: assert an age on anything that stamps itself, and pin the files that must carry a stamp.
